content: {"praised":["Faithful to the original book, no scenes cut.","Complex, convoluted plot with many red herrings.","Good mystery atmosphere reminiscent of Petherbridge dramatizations.","Surprising twist in killer identity, keeps viewers engaged.","Strong directing and music enhance period setting."],"criticized":["Poor acting, not convincing.","Low production quality, looks like videotape.","Boring and out of touch storyline.","Considered worst Christie movie by some.","Unengaging pacing and tone." ]}
